tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Deepest ground: the Surface and Journey worlds. Text on every light world (About, Code, Contact).

tokens.name: bone-100
tokens.usage: Text on ink worlds. Ground of the Code world. Primary button fill on ink.

tokens.name: paper-50
tokens.usage: Initial and label on the cobalt E-smart Capitais panel (8.0:1).

tokens.name: stone-300
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ink-900 (12:1): hero tagline, scroll hint.

tokens.name: ember-500
tokens.usage: The signature accent and the only tweakable color. Ground of the About world, the hero portal, the status pulse, the Case Mate panel. Never used for body text on light grounds.

tokens.name: cobalt-600
tokens.usage: E-smart Capitais panel ground in the Journey world. Only as a panel ground, never as a link or text color.

tokens.name: cream-50
tokens.usage: Mio Geek panel ground, behind its logo (the logo image is drawn with mix-blend-mode: multiply so its cream background melts into this).

tokens.name: lime-300
tokens.usage: Ground of the Contact world, the bottom of the dive. Text on it is ink-900 (15:1).

tokens.name: moss-700
tokens.usage: Organifi project panel ground.

tokens.name: moss-100
tokens.usage: Organifi panel initial and label, on moss-700.

tokens.name: crimson-800
tokens.usage: Crimson Agility project panel ground.

tokens.name: crimson-100
tokens.usage: Crimson Agility panel initial and label, on crimson-800.

tokens.name: hud-glass
tokens.usage: Depth HUD pill ground, always with backdrop-filter: blur(10px). Readable over every world.

tokens.name: hud-tip
tokens.usage: HUD hover label chip ground.

tokens.name: world-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the current world. Each level of the dive is one theme: set data-theme on the world element.

tokens.name: world-ink
tokens.usage: Text, 1.5px rules, outlined buttons and chips inside the current world. Components use currentColor, so this is usually the only color they need.

tokens.name: world-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text in the current world. Every pair passes 4.5:1 on its world-bg.

tokens.name: world-rule-soft
tokens.usage: 1px dividers between skill list items. Decorative only, never a control border.

tokens.name: world-next
tokens.usage: Fill of the portal O in this world: always the NEXT world's ground, so the hole reads as a window into the level below. Contact has no portal.

styles.name: name-hero
styles.usage: Hero name only. Fluid: min(16.5vw, 27vh). The O is a portal (see Portal). CALAZANS sits under it at 0.42em, weight 300, letter-spacing 0.01em.

styles.name: level-title
styles.usage: One per level, uppercase, nowrap. Fluid: min(calc(80vw / (var(--len) * 0.95)), 22vh) where --len is the word's letter count. Its O is drawn as a ring.

styles.name: portal-word
styles.usage: The next level's name at the end of a level, centered. Fluid: min(calc(84vw / (var(--len) * 0.95)), 22vh). Its O is the clickable portal.

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: A stack técnica por trás de cada loja.
styles.usage: One lead sentence per level, max-width 22ch. Fluid: clamp(22px, 3.3vw, 46px).

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Fact figures. Fluid: clamp(40px, 5.4vw, 76px).

styles.name: project-name
styles.usage: Journey card titles. Fluid: clamp(32px, 4vw, 56px).

styles.name: company
styles.usage: Reserved for compact company lists. Fluid: clamp(28px, 3.4vw, 48px).

styles.name: marquee
styles.usage: The stack ticker. Fluid: clamp(26px, 3.4vw, 48px).

styles.name: role
styles.usage: Hero role line, followed by a blinking caret. Fluid: clamp(22px, 2.6vw, 36px).

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card headings (education). Fluid: clamp(22px, 2.4vw, 34px).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Me importo obsessivamente com performance, código limpo e execução pixel-perfect.
styles.usage: Running text, max-width 56ch, text-wrap: pretty. Fluid: clamp(17px, 1.5vw, 21px).

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Manutenção e escalabilidade de storefronts para múltiplas marcas.
styles.usage: Small running text where body is too large.

styles.name: list-item
styles.usage: Skill list rows. Fluid: clamp(18px, 1.6vw, 22px).

styles.name: contact-row
styles.usage: Contact list values. Fluid: clamp(18px, 1.9vw, 26px).

styles.name: role-title
styles.usage: Strong one-line labels in body text.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: All buttons and button-styled links.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Project tags.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Every eyebrow, level header, field label and meta line. Always text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Hero top links (desktop only) and the mateo.dev wordmark suffix.

styles.name: hud
styles.usage: HUD language buttons and hover labels, uppercase.

styles.name: depth
styles.usage: The vertical depth readout inside the HUD, writing-mode: vertical-rl rotated 180deg. Hidden under 760px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: HUD inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, HUD padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label-to-title gaps, stacked meta.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Form field gaps, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button and card inner padding, footer gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Level header top padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Experience row padding, bottom padding before a portal line.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Grid gaps between columns at desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a level. Fluid: clamp(40px, 6vw, 80px).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between project cards. Fluid: clamp(48px, 7vw, 96px).

tokens.name: gutter-left
tokens.usage: Left page gutter. Fluid: clamp(20px, 4vw, 56px).

tokens.name: gutter-right
tokens.usage: Right page gutter, reserved for the HUD pill. Fluid: clamp(64px, 7vw, 104px); 52px under 760px. Content never enters it; only the full-bleed marquee passes under the HUD.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Inputs and textarea.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and project panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, badges, the HUD.

tokens.name: radius-disc
tokens.usage: Portals, level-title rings, dots.

tokens.name: hud-ring
tokens.usage: Hairline around the HUD pill. The system has no other shadows.

stroke.note: Lines are drawn in currentColor (world-ink) at full strength. No grey borders.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Section rules, card and button borders, field borders, fact top rules.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Skill list dividers (world-rule-soft) and the HUD ring.

dive.note: Parameters of the scroll-driven zoom. The full algorithm is in the Dive mechanics section.

tokens.name: dive-distance
tokens.usage: Scroll distance of one dive, in viewport heights.

tokens.name: portal-size
tokens.usage: Diameter of every portal and ring O, relative to the word's font size.

tokens.name: zoom-floor
tokens.usage: Minimum zoom factor K between two worlds.

tokens.name: zoom-margin
tokens.usage: K = max(zoom-floor, zoom-margin × viewport diagonal ÷ portal diameter), so the portal circle always covers the screen at the end of a dive.

tokens.name: depth-step
tokens.usage: Meters of depth per level shown in the HUD (−0250 M … −1000 M at Contact).

tokens.name: level-count
tokens.usage: Surface, About, Code, Journey, Contact.

timing.note: Durations and the one easing curve. The dive itself has no duration: it follows the scroll.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Every hover and UI transition.

tokens.name: t-hover
tokens.usage: Button lift, arrow nudge, HUD opacity.

tokens.name: t-portal
tokens.usage: Portal hover ring.

tokens.name: t-pulse
tokens.usage: Availability dot and the In development badge pulse.

tokens.name: t-caret
tokens.usage: Blinking caret after Theme Architect, steps(1).

tokens.name: t-bob
tokens.usage: Scroll hint float, 7px.

tokens.name: t-marquee
tokens.usage: One full loop of the stack ticker, linear.
